via_smd_paste_audit.audit_method: Native Collide with actual drill radius, same-net included, native paste margins, no SHAPE.Distance

findings.detail: C3 relocation had placed its GND drill hole over its SMD copper/paste. Moved only GND via to(57.8,92.1) and extended one existing F.Cu track; native DRC/parity/opens zero.

Original U5 via→C15/C16 In2-only routes were28.02193/31.14411mm via y59.55 despite sharing one plane island. Accepted one0.30mm B.Cu bridge between existing power vias closes a local U5–C15 bypass in2.469mm XY plus two existing vias. C15–C16 has a3.57782mm local In2 route. U3/U4/U7/U8 local saved-copper routes separately verified.
U1 EP has working external thermal vias and In1 plane, but no F.Cu thermal pour. Do not apply JEDEC board thermal numbers or declare safe enclosure temperature without test.
Minimum nominal drill-edge gap to SMD copper and paste is0.090mm at U5.7. Hole lies outside both; fabrication/mask/stencil registration tolerances require JLC DFM acceptance.

thermal_and_DFM_release_gates: Qualify U1/LDO/battery temperatures in the real enclosure; no F.Cu ground heat-spreader pour exists.
